title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.
AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

You mentioned your focus on customers with volume, so the attached packages give you a 24- or 36-month commitment for our full need, with no index clause. You can choose your payment terms. Which package can you confirm for your pricing committee?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment and can offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit with 30 days payment. As we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month period, we must include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our primary offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – revised packages incl. AS-14404 option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand your concern about a fixed price over 24 months. One attached package therefore includes the AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband, which protects your margin against larger alloy moves in either direction. The other packages keep the price fixed, one of them with a 36-month commitment that secures your volume for longer. All packages cover our full need of 23700 kg per year.

Which of these can you confirm? Is there a cheaper variant, for example in bar tolerance or packaging, that would help you further?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – revised packages incl. AS-14404 option
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Regarding your technical inquiry, our standard bar tolerances and packaging are already fully optimized for cost-efficiency, leaving no room for cheaper variants.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As an alternative, we value the proposed 36-month commitment and can offer a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, provided the AS-14404 index clause is included to manage long-term risk.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body: Thank you. We accept your alternative package as quoted and attach it unchanged; please confirm it.

We look forward to our continued cooperation. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our Angebot stays valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
